|rulings=* The term 'steal' on this Utinni Effect is simply flavor text meaning to place the Necklace card on the target Imperial. Stealing rules do not apply.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Organa%27s%20Ceremonial%20Necklace</ref>
* In order to pass [[Organa's Ceremonial Necklace]] to an adjacent site you control, you must immediately re-target (place it on) another one of your Imperials there.
